conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R04050의 적용 맥락: This paper studies Brazil’s formal manufacturing sector using linked employer–employee (RAIS) and customs (SECEX) data for 1986–1998. Units are firms and workers in manufacturing; analyses exploit cross-sectional variation in firm employment, wages, and export participation after late‑1980s/early‑1990s trade liberalization (tariff cuts and removal of non‑tariff barriers) and the 1995 real appreciation. The authors estimate a heterogeneous‑firm structural model (maximum likelihood) and run Mincer and firm‑level regressions to quantify trade’s effects on wage inequality.
